mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, it is a chilly 30 degrees at Verona Community Park under foggy skies, with the moon in its first quarter phase. If you look up tonight at 6:34 PM, you can catch the ISS passing for two minutes, rising in the west-northwest over Cross Plains and traveling toward the northeast over the Home Depot area.

The Verona Plan Commission has several pending development projects on their agenda for December 7th, including a new site plan and conditional use permit for the Sub-Zero facility at Liberty Business Park. Additionally, official notices regarding the fall general election and spring election are available on the city website.

We have plenty of action this week, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge with trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's, plus enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's.

Regarding local safety, on October 23, officers made contact with two juveniles riding prohibited e-Motos on Ashton Drive, which resulted in their parents receiving citations for permitting a minor to drive a motor vehicle.
For a sweet treat today, head over to Culver's for the Chocolate Volcano flavor; the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
